title: Exclude fixed-prebirth BIT gains with late exterior correction (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** This scoped exclusion allows late coframed exterior correction for the 60 old rank-seven carrier payloads on the retained BIT word. The exact joint ranks are 148, 148, and 100 for successively larger old source libraries. The largest gives a 48-dimensional kernel, but none of the ten singleton marked libraries gains a direction at its fixed prebirth clock. The same zero holds with every protected-paid and exterior constraint waived. Pooling every carrier source across all charts and clocks gives nine new directions per bank individually, which isolates the timed reachability obstruction.

The complete directed stock uppers at zero, one, and two separate split fees are 14, 16, and 18. The exact rational upper margins at κ = 10018846261809/2500000000000000 are in the result. The best is below −0.8858451573064097 even with ordinary setup, routing, ownership, restoration, precision and tape work granted free. The result leaves the signed supplier, full paid profile and selected record unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Task card: bit-helper-contract, with changed scope recorded in TASK.json. Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Scientific head a5de6fb272e58809ca95cc2c67919cab5e8b79bc. The separate existing navigation commit f2206e608167995b9b96b7e340b3558f2b578490 is inherited for hosted checking. #7271 fixes old paid payloads. #7272 changes the 60 payloads and requires unchanged exterior outputs. This package independently regenerates the #7272 library, grants explicit late corrections, then waives all exterior and protected-paid equations to certify the fixed-clock ceiling. #7264 supplies the separate synthetic stock-bound sharpness comparison. No additional site test is needed for this scope.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled:

    python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-late-exterior-compensation
    python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-late-exterior-compensation --check-modes --check-source-history
    python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_current_status.py

Local CPython 3.12.14 passed the registered replay, all six navigation tests and committed source bindings. The independent column-rank and terminal-intersection audits passed. The Git-free payload replay also passed with empty PATH and working directory. Altered source, duplicate manifest paths, forged coefficient rank and forged singleton expansion were rejected. Exact inputs, predecessor reconstruction, recorded result and proofs are in [the package](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/tree/a5de6fb272e58809ca95cc2c67919cab5e8b79bc/research/bit-late-exterior-compensation). The selected cold replay and a changed all-size supplier were outside the experiment. #7257 tracks the separate inherited historical CI source-drift repair.
